This full-time position requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in automation engineering, focusing on Substation Automation Systems. Key Responsibilities Perform Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). Support testing and commissioning activities for Substation Automation Systems (SAS). Provide technical support to the team. Handle BCU and protection relay configuration. Prepare technical and weekly reports. Coordinate with Design, Materials, and Projects Departments. dd0d2d2628bbaf26.description: About the Role AMAD Hospital is seeking a Consultant of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires a physician who will lead and supervise the delivery of high-quality, evidence-based care, focusing on the effective diagnosis, management, and treatment of patients. The Consultant is expected to demonstrate clinical excellence within their specialty and provide leadership and training to junior medical staff. Key Responsibilities Lead, support, implement, and adhere to AMAD Hospital’s departmental and divisional initiatives, policies, and procedures. Ensure comprehensive documentation in medical records to accurately reflect patient diagnoses and treatments, supporting good clinical practice and accurate billing. Provide general accountability for the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of general health problems. Deliver best-in-class rehabilitation services and holistic rehabilitation care based on best evidence medicine practice. Direct nurses in procedures for preoperative and postoperative care, including administering sedatives, prescribing diets, and preparing operative areas. Examine patients and determine necessary x-ray examinations and clinical laboratory tests. Perform and interpret diagnostic tests to gather information on medical conditions and determine diagnoses. Administer and prescribe conservative treatment measures such as antibiotics, drugs, and compresses. Explain procedures and discuss test results or prescribed treatments with patients and their families. Monitor patient conditions and progress, re-evaluating treatments as necessary. Collect, record, and maintain patient information, including medical history reports and examination results. Refer patients to medical specialists or other practitioners when necessary. Conduct daily clinics and take on-call duty outside of scheduled working hours. Perform additional tasks and duties as assigned, within the scope of the individual’s knowledge, skills, and abilities. Quality Improvement and Collaboration Contribute to leading quality improvement initiatives within the Department. Facilitate effective cross-functional communication to optimize patient care. Support a culture of regular audit and encourage the use of audit results for improving clinical practice. Support the reporting, investigation, and response to untoward incidents. Experience Required Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

This full-time role involves ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to specified quality standards. The Director, Construction will contribute to ROSHN's mission of delivering high-quality communities to Saudi citizens. About ROSHN ROSHN is a national real estate developer supported by the Public Investment Fund. The company is dedicated to creating improved standards of living across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia by delivering homes to thousands of people. ROSHN aims to strengthen the country’s socio-economic fabric in line with Vision 2030 through the construction of high-quality places that blend modern design with local culture and tradition. Core Values and Team Culture ROSHN operates with a core strength in delivering through teamwork, united by common goals and a commitment to fulfilling promises. The company values and respects its customers, partners, and the communities it builds. Emphasis is placed on the beauty and heritage of its developments, as well as the quality of life offered to residents. ROSHN employs a skilled, experienced, and talented team, valuing their expertise and potential to deliver desirable neighborhoods. Responsibilities Oversee all construction projects from inception to completion. Ensure projects adhere to established timelines and budgetary constraints. Maintain and enforce quality standards across all construction activities. Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to achieve project objectives. Qualifications and Requirements 0-1 years of experience in construction management or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage complex construction projects. Strong understanding of construction processes, quality control, and budget management. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time Director, Construction position at ROSHN are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

Their expertise covers areas such as computer vision, Large Language Model (LLM) applications, speech-to-text technology, data intelligence, and low-code AI solutions. The Role of AI Engineer, Specialist Nabeh is seeking an AI Engineer, Specialist to contribute to the development, optimization, testing, and deployment of AI and machine learning solutions. This full-time role focuses on applications across Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Speech AI, and Generative AI. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models. Build AI solutions across Computer Vision, NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs), Speech-to-Text, and Text-to-Speech. Prepare, process, and manage datasets for model training, validation, and evaluation. Integrate AI models into enterprise applications and systems using REST APIs. Support AI model deployment across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments. Collaborate with AI, Backend, DevOps, and QA teams to transition prototypes into production. Monitor model performance, troubleshoot issues, and maintain technical documentation. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering and model development. Strong proficiency in Python and experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow. Knowledge of Computer Vision, NLP, LLMs, and Speech AI. Experience with REST APIs, SQL, Pandas, and NumPy. Familiarity with Git, Docker, and foundational MLOps practices. Understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle, including model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

dd764f21eb23303e.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Specialist - Governance (Reporting) to support governance reporting activities. This full-time role involves preparing, analyzing, and maintaining governance-related reports, dashboards, and management information to facilitate effective oversight and decision-making. The specialist will provide analytical support for governance committees, leadership reporting, and governance performance monitoring, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with governance requirements. Role Responsibilities Prepare and maintain governance reports, dashboards, scorecards, and management information for governance committees and leadership teams. Collect, consolidate, validate, and analyze governance-related data from various business functions and reporting sources. Monitor governance actions, decisions, performance indicators, and reporting obligations to ensure accurate status tracking and reporting. Support the preparation of governance committee reports, executive summaries, presentations, and briefing materials. Maintain governance reporting templates, databases, trackers, and document repositories. Review reporting submissions for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and alignment with governance requirements. Analyze governance trends, reporting outcomes, action plan progress, and key performance indicators to support management decision-making. Coordinate with business units and stakeholders to obtain reporting information and resolve data quality issues. Support governance reviews, audits, and compliance assessments by providing governance-related reports and supporting documentation. Assist in developing reporting enhancements, automation opportunities, and dashboard improvements to strengthen reporting effectiveness. Ensure confidentiality and proper management of sensitive governance information and records. Contribute to governance process improvement initiatives and the implementation of governance best practices. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Corporate Governance, Finance, Management, Economics, Law, Information Systems, or a related field. GRCP, CGI/ICSA Governance Qualification, CRMA, PMP, or equivalent certification is preferred. 5–8 years of experience in governance, reporting, compliance, risk management, corporate secretariat, business reporting, or related disciplines. Demonstrated experience in preparing governance reports, dashboards, and management information. Experience in supporting governance committees, leadership reporting, and performance monitoring activities. Experience in collecting, validating, and analyzing business or governance data. Experience in coordinating with stakeholders across multiple business functions. Experience in supporting governance reviews, audits, and compliance-related reporting requirements. Work Environment This is a full-time position within Qiddiya Investment Company, focusing on governance reporting functions. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply.

ddf0827b19e2fdc6.description: Job Purpose To develop, enhance, and maintain digital banking applications using the Kony/Temenos Infinity platform, delivering secure, reliable, and user-friendly mobile and digital banking solutions. The role involves developing digital banking features, integrating applications with core banking systems such as Temenos T24, and supporting application performance, quality, and production stability within a banking environment. Key Responsibilities Develop, enhance, and maintain mobile and digital banking applications using Kony (Temenos Infinity) platform . Implement new banking features and functionalities based on business requirements and technical specifications. Integrate digital banking applications with Temenos T24 / Transact core banking systems and other backend services. Develop and maintain application integrations using REST APIs, web services, and other integration technologies. Work on mobile banking applications for Android and iOS platforms. Customize UI components, application workflows, and business logic to meet banking requirements. Troubleshoot application issues, perform debugging, and resolve defects across development, testing, and production environments. Collaborate with business analysts, UI/UX designers, QA teams, backend developers, and infrastructure teams throughout the development lifecycle. Participate in application testing, code reviews, deployments, releases, and post-deployment support. Ensure applications meet banking requirements related to security, performance, reliability, and user experience. Support application maintenance, enhancements, and production issues in coordination with digital banking and IT operations teams. Follow coding standards, development best practices, and established SDLC procedures. Contribute to continuous improvement of digital banking services and application performance. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in mobile or digital banking application development. Hands-on experience with Kony / Temenos Infinity development platform . Experience developing and maintaining mobile banking or enterprise mobile applications. Good knowledge of JavaScript and front-end development technologies. Experience with API integration, RESTful web services, JSON, and backend connectivity. Familiarity with mobile application development for Android and iOS. Understanding of digital banking services, banking workflows, and financial transactions. Experience integrating digital banking applications with Temenos T24 / Transact or other core banking systems is highly preferred. Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure mobile application development practices. Experience with application troubleshooting, debugging, testing, and deployment. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced banking technology environment.

dd1ef7699d8256c8.description: About the Role Jasara Program Management Company is seeking an experienced Director Landscape & Parks to lead the strategic development, delivery, and management of landscape and parks assets for a major destination development in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. Role Overview The Director will lead the strategic management, governance, and optimization of landscape, parks, and public realm assets across a large-scale destination development. This role oversees the full asset lifecycle, from development planning, design assurance, and delivery through commissioning, handover, operational readiness, and long-term asset management. The Director ensures that parks, green spaces, landscape infrastructure, and associated public realm assets are fit for purpose, sustainable, accessible, maintainable, and aligned with operational requirements, visitor experience, and long-term asset performance. Key Responsibilities Establish and implement the strategic framework for managing landscape, parks, and public realm assets throughout their lifecycle, including asset registers, condition assessments, performance monitoring, and lifecycle management plans. Oversee asset acceptance and handover governance, establishing criteria, technical standards, and reviewing proposed asset transfers for completeness, compliance, maintainability, and operational readiness. Manage the operational management and maintenance of parks, gardens, green corridors, streetscapes, recreational spaces, and public realm assets, establishing maintenance strategies, service standards, and KPIs. Provide strategic oversight of landscape planning, design development, and technical reviews to ensure alignment with long-term operational and maintenance requirements, considering lifecycle costs, climate resilience, and water efficiency. Drive sustainable landscape and parks management practices, including water conservation, efficient irrigation, native planting, and biodiversity enhancement, while optimizing resource utilization. Oversee CAPEX and OPEX planning, asset lifecycle costs, and maintenance budgets, evaluating financial implications and establishing cost-control mechanisms. Lead multidisciplinary teams and establish governance frameworks, coordinating with development, engineering, construction, facilities management, and other stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in landscape and parks management, preferably within large-scale destination developments. Demonstrated experience in strategic asset management, design assurance, and operational oversight of public realm assets. Proven ability to establish and implement asset lifecycle frameworks and governance. Experience in financial and commercial management related to landscape and parks assets. Required Skills Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities. Expertise in sustainable landscape practices and resource optimization. Proficiency in asset performance monitoring and lifecycle management planning. Ability to coordinate with diverse teams and external consultants/contractors. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves working within a dynamic environment focused on major destination development projects.

dd3729292ee5e557.description: We are looking for an organized and proactive Academy Operations Administrator to support and coordinate the operational activities of KAUST Academy's Pre-University Programs. The role involves managing the end-to-end administrative and operational processes, including program planning, student admissions, academic coordination, scheduling, stakeholder communication, reporting, and certification. The ideal candidate should have strong organizational and communication skills, with fluency in both Arabic and English. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and oversee the planning, development, and execution of Academy programs. Prepare program offers, educational materials, presentations, and promotional documents. Manage student admissions, selection, registration, and enrollment processes. Coordinate academic activities, course delivery, and program schedules. Liaise with students, parents, instructors, clients, and internal and external stakeholders. Deliver program presentations and communicate effectively in Arabic and English. Monitor student progress, conduct evaluations, and prepare program performance reports. Prepare and issue certificates for successful program graduates. Maintain accurate student records, databases, and program documentation. Assist in preparing and monitoring program budgets and financial reports. Resolve operational and program-related issues in coordination with the Program Manager. Ensure compliance with Academy policies, procedures, and operational standards. Identify opportunities to improve program efficiency and service quality. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related field. A Master's degree is preferred. Minimum 3 years of experience in program coordination, academic administration, project coordination, or operations administration. Fluency in Arabic and English (written and spoken) is mandatory. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Experience in program administration, student coordination, scheduling, and reporting. Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to multitask, manage priorities, and work independently and collaboratively.

dd3a3f9a03dc13b0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سبورتس أوبيريشنز عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يمثل هذا الدور نقطة الاتصال الأولى للزوار والعملاء، ويتطلب شخصًا قادرًا على تقديم تجربة استقبال احترافية ومنظمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد احتياجاتهم، وتزويدهم بالمعلومات اللازمة. إبلاغ الأقسام أو الموظفين المعنيين بوجود الزوار والعملاء وتوجيههم إليهم. التعامل مع المكالمات الهاتفية الواردة، والرد على الاستفسارات، أو تحويل المكالمات إلى الجهات المختصة. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية لجمع المعلومات المطلوبة عند الحاجة. تنظيم وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات، وتسجيل بيانات الزوار والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة. الالتزام التام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة والأدلة الإجرائية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بلباقة واحترافية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهيًا وكتابيًا. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل جدة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

dd7ad277d2b56bcc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسفاري للصيانة والنظافة عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية الخاصة بالمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع والتأكد من مطابقة المواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل المواقع الإنشائية. مهارات في إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية والمخططات الهندسية. القدرة على الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع ومطابقة المواصفات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص، وستتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع متنوعة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: الرياض. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة اسفاري للصيانة والنظافة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

ddafd0abfc749007.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اركي عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، إعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بدقة. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع والتأكد من مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، بما في ذلك نسبة تقدمها، وعرضها، وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل البيانات الطبوغرافية والجيولوجية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وإعداد المخططات. مهارات جيدة في إعداد جداول الكميات والمواصفات الفنية. القدرة على الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية وضمان الجودة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال الهندسة المدنية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين الطموحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في اركي.

ddbd6ec003be88ac.description: About the Role DP World is seeking a Senior Officer Admin & Government Relations to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supervising government relations activities, overseeing transactions, permits, and compliance requirements, and ensuring timely service delivery through effective coordination with government authorities and internal stakeholders. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily government relations activities and transactions, including timely processing of visas, work permits, iqamas, sponsorship transfers, profession changes, and exit/re-entry visas. Coordinate and maintain effective working relationships with government authorities, ministries, regulatory bodies, and port-related entities. Manage the issuance, renewal, amendment, and cancellation of commercial registrations, licenses, permits, and government certifications, ensuring compliance with labor, immigration, and regulatory requirements. Monitor changes in laws, regulations, and government procedures, assess their operational impact, and recommend corrective actions. Track Saudization compliance and workforce localization requirements, prepare periodic reports, and highlight compliance risks. Prepare, review, and process official letters, certificates, declarations, No Objection Letters (NOCs), and other government-related documentation, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with all departments regarding government-related requirements, provide guidance on procedures, and support resolution of government platform issues. Administer activities on government portals and platforms such as Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, MOFA, Balady, and Zawil, ensuring data accuracy. Monitor visa balances, permit validity, and compliance trackers, and provide regular operational and financial updates to management. Government Liaison and Compliance This role involves acting as a primary liaison with various government authorities, ministries, and regulatory bodies. The Senior Officer will attend official meetings, inspections, and audits as required, following up on pending cases and supporting the resolution of escalated government-related matters. A key aspect is ensuring continuous compliance with applicable labor, immigration, and regulatory requirements, proactively monitoring renewal schedules, and mitigating potential compliance risks. Regulatory Monitoring and Reporting The Senior Officer will be responsible for monitoring changes in laws, regulations, and government procedures that may impact business operations. This includes assessing operational impact, providing recommendations to management, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions to maintain compliance. The role also involves preparing periodic Saudization reports, highlighting compliance risks, gaps, and required actions, and ensuring all government relations records and trackers are accurately maintained and regularly updated. Internal Coordination and Team Support Effective internal coordination is crucial, requiring collaboration with all departments regarding government-related requirements. The Senior Officer will provide guidance on government procedures, documentation, and compliance matters, and support the resolution of government platform and system-related issues. Additionally, the role includes guiding and supporting direct reports in completing assigned activities, monitoring workload distribution and service delivery performance, and supporting training, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives within the team. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in administrative and government relations roles. Demonstrated ability to manage government transactions, permits, and compliance. Strong understanding of Saudi labor, immigration, and regulatory requirements. Proficiency in using government portals and platforms (*, Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, MOFA, Balady, Zawil). Excellent coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

ddb570c159955de7.description: Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager – DLP and Snagging to coordinate Defects Liability Period management and snagging across all divisions. Supporting a destination bringing entertainment, sports and culture together, you will help ensure outstanding defects are tracked, rectification responsibilities remain clear, and completed works are supported by verified evidence. What you’ll do Manage the defect lifecycle: Coordinate a consistent process for defect notification, allocation, rectification tracking, technical verification and close-out across multiple assets and divisions. Own accurate, traceable records: Maintain consolidated snagging registers and controlled documentation covering inspections, correspondence, photographs, test results, warranties and closure approvals. Stay ahead of contractual milestones: Track phased handovers, DLP commencement and expiry dates, notification cut-offs and warranty obligations, validating requirements with Delivery and Commercial teams. Drive coordinated rectification: Lead close-out meetings, maintain action plans and follow up with contractors and divisional representatives on overdue, recurring or disputed defects. Ensure evidence-based closure: Arrange inspections, specialist verification and retesting, securing supporting evidence and asset-owner confirmation before recording closure. Reopen incomplete or ineffective rectifications where required. Protect operational continuity: Coordinate rectification access, permits and shutdowns with operational teams, ensuring works follow approved safety and service-continuity arrangements. Support pre-expiry reviews: Coordinate inspections ahead of DLP deadlines and prepare close-out packs identifying unresolved defects, residual risks and missing evidence to support authorised contractual decisions. Provide clear reporting and escalation: Report on open and overdue defects, ageing, critical issues, approaching expiries and verified closures. Reconcile records with CAFM and asset information teams, maintaining the distinction between construction defects and routine maintenance.
